It is not in my plan at all to be trading demo or even test trading yet, but I could not resist and wanted to see how I dealt with it.

I hope I can explain this as I saw it, here goes....

I saw on the weekly we were in a Demand buying zone, so I was watching all the other lower time frames for potential P.A set ups.

I finally found quite good P.A on the hourly, first off I saw average CP, the white zones are what I believed to be consumed orders, except he zone in yellow, this was still fresh. Being eager to enter a trade, I decided @ number 1 this was good enough as price seemed to consume most of the sell orders in the yellow zone, and I saw a FL @ number 2 below, so I placed a limit order to enter long and got stopped. I then saw price form a demand base @ number 3 and then the all important engulf happened @ number 4, my entry missed by two pips near number 4. So, price rallied right to my target, the end of the CP zone, and formed a nice-looking cap @ number 5. I thought considering price did not even enter my original demand zone @ 4, I believed there may have been still some buy orders left, so I left my order in place, price triggered me in @ A, and rallied to my target @ B.

A great learning experience for me, and really enjoyed it. I knew it meant nothing and no money was involved, but the nerves got tested and my emotions were still on high.

Cheers

DT
